name: OutlierKit
description:
Capabilities (10 read-only tools):
• Outlier video search — semantic search across OutlierKit's index of high-performing
  "outlier" videos, ranked by how far each beats its channel's norm.
• Channel discovery — find outlier channels by topic, or channels similar to one you track.
• Deep lookups — full details for any video or channel, plus a channel's recent uploads.
• Transcripts & comments — pull a video's transcript and its top or newest comments.
• Keyword research — expand seed terms into ranked keyword ideas with monthly search volumes.
• Deep/live search — fetch the freshest results directly when you need what's new.

Built on OutlierKit's own outlier-detection engine and enriched YouTube metadata — ideal
for creators, agencies, and marketers doing content research, competitor analysis, and
idea validation without leaving Claude.

Requires a paid OutlierKit plan; calls draw from your OutlierKit credit balance. Connect
by signing in with Google.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OutlierKit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OutlierKit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://outlierkit.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OutlierKit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OutlierKit provides these MCP tools: channels_get, channels_search, channels_similar, channels_videos, keywords_research, outliers_refresh, outliers_search, videos_comments, videos_get, and videos_transcript.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OutlierKit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to OutlierKit in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
OutlierKit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OutlierKit is developed by OutlierKit. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
